dct_description_sm: Since 2012, this case has been played 15095 times.

13yo female comes back from basketball practice complaining of pain in her right foot. Explores team communications, virtual roles. 

Premise: This is about communications with a team environment. FHT stuff. Based on a simple ankle injury. Need to decide what key points you want to convey. Main things are: 1. Avoid the common help seeking paths of ER and walkin clinics -- there are other options. 2. Communication between professionals -- which are the most appropriate methods 3. Perspectives of seeing issues from another person
